title: Alpha Lab point-in-time research and shadow evidence
goal: Build a lawful and reproducible point-in-time SEC, market-price and FX evidence base, falsify or validate one frozen Form-4 hypothesis out of sample, and operate an append-only shadow portfolio without any route to real orders or capital.
completion: A license- and timestamp-bound SEC, market-price, FX and corporate-action archive can reproduce every decision input without future data.
The preregistered hypothesis is evaluated out of sample against fixed baselines and declared stress tests without post-hoc rule selection.
At least 200 independent eligible signals and six months of untouched append-only live-shadow evidence yield an explicit no-go or independent-review decision; no real-capital action is automatic.
